Parts.Description: Warm golden sand with dunes, a sandstone plaza for the pyramid and a sun-stone circle for the Pharaoh.
Parts.Name: Desert Sands

Parts.Description: The mighty pyramid of the pharaoh: a huge sandstone mountain with a golden tip and a dark entrance.
Parts.Name: Great Pyramid

Parts.Description: A giant lion with the head of a king, guarding the pyramid with a calm stare.
Parts.Name: Great Sphinx

Parts.Description: The sun gate of the temple: two sloping towers with flagpoles, a golden sun disc and a doorway.
Parts.Name: Temple Pylon

Parts.Description: Two tall granite needles carved with hieroglyphs and tipped with gold.
Parts.Name: Twin Obelisks

Parts.Description: A cool blue pond ringed with green grass, reeds and three leaning date palms.
Parts.Name: Palm Oasis

Parts.Description: Four tall date palms bent by the desert wind, heavy with bunches of dates.
Parts.Name: Date Palm Grove

Parts.Description: Three market stalls with striped awnings, baskets of spices and big clay jars.
Parts.Name: Desert Bazaar

Parts.Description: Two black jackal-headed statues with golden collars watch over the road.
Parts.Name: Anubis Guardians

Parts.Description: A sleepy camel in a red saddle blanket, with trade crates and a water jar.
Parts.Name: Camel Caravan

Parts.Description: Two rows of tall columns topped with lotus flowers along a sandstone terrace.
Parts.Name: Lotus Colonnade

Parts.Description: A tomb cut into a sandstone cliff, with a pillared doorway and two jackal watchers.
Parts.Name: Rock Tomb

Parts.Description: A long carved wall painted with gods, birds and golden cartouches.
Parts.Name: Hieroglyph Wall

Parts.Description: The sun god's golden disc held between two sandstone pillars on a stepped platform.
Parts.Name: Sun Disc Shrine

Parts.Description: A giant falcon god with the double crown, standing on a stone plinth.
Parts.Name: Falcon of Horus

Parts.Description: A big shiny scarab beetle, symbol of the rising sun, on a carved plinth.
Parts.Name: Golden Scarab

Parts.Description: Three flat-roofed mudbrick houses with a roof ladder, drying pots and a woven mat.
Parts.Name: Mudbrick Houses

Parts.Description: A simple lever well: a long pole with a clay counterweight and a bucket, watering the garden.
Parts.Name: Shaduf Well

Parts.Description: A golden royal boat with a tall prow and stern, a canopy and steering oars, afloat on a blue canal.
Parts.Name: Solar Barge

Parts.Description: A golden coffin of a pharaoh resting under a pillared canopy with two fire bowls.
Parts.Name: Golden Sarcophagus

Parts.Description: Three small pyramids for the queens, linked by a sandstone causeway.
Parts.Name: Queens Pyramids

Parts.Description: A shady pavilion with striped silk curtains, a golden throne and two feather fans.
Parts.Name: Royal Pavilion

Parts.Description: Open chests spilling gold coins, jewels and golden jars: the royal treasure.
Parts.Name: Treasure Vault

Parts.Description: A golden balance weighing a heart against the feather of truth.
Parts.Name: Scales of Truth

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant golden death mask with blue striped headcloth on a stepped dais.
Parts.Name: Golden Pharaoh Mask
